minutes.headline: Charter Review Committee set a working Nov. 13 special Town Meeting target and agreed to pull back contested changes.
minutes.summary: The committee welcomed two new members, approved minutes, and reviewed feedback from the public hearing. It agreed to pull back proposed changes to the library, cemetery and parks boards, recheck the town accountant appointment, and split proposals into separate articles. A November special Town Meeting was used as a working date, and the next meeting was set for June 27.
